content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge rules a verse-pair UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of stand the rule governs.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase 'thy father' is immediately qualified by the child's reference to 'my Father's business.'", "rule_words": "A judge may not rest STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED on one verse failing to state a link or its contrary.", "room": "'one verse failing to state a link': the judge could be read as resting on the single pair Luke 2:48-49; but it cites two prior chain sections whose support is multi-verse and gives an affirmative inferential reason (the qualifier in the child's reply), not a bare failure-to-state.", "why": "The judge does not rest on a mere failure to state; it points to an affirmative qualification within the passage and to prior multi-verse chain answers."}
